verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents scoped API keys limited by source IP (CIDR) and by domain, directly addressing scoped credentials and IP allowlisting (porkbun-docs-15/43), and confirms API keys work independent of account 2FA so 2FA isn't weakened for automation (porkbun-docs-37). However, there is no first-party documentation of the 2FA mechanism itself (TOTP, hardware key, etc.) — only a stray community mention of using a passkey (porkbun-comm-6) — so the 'real 2FA' half of the story is thinly evidenced. Missing for 10: detailed docs on 2FA setup/methods, independent verification that IP allowlisting is enforced in practice, and any audit/pen-test evidence of account hardening.
